stories.title: What's Trump's strategy now with Iran? To keep things as they are
stories.description: President Trump says the "status quo" is what Gulf Arab allies want as the Iran war hits a stalemate and the U.S. midterms force a pivot from threats of attacks to economic pressure.

stories.title: Bahrain court sentences dozens of Shia Muslims to life in prison, activists say
stories.description: Most of those jailed on Iran-linked terrorism charges are clerics, a UK-based human rights group, claiming confessions were forced. Bahraini authorities accused the 69 unnamed defendants of establishing a terrorist group linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards.

stories.title: Yemeni forces retreat to defend port city from Houthis
stories.description: Saudi-backed forces say they are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to protect the interim capital, Aden.

stories.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
stories.description: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: UN watchdog 'increasingly concerned' over uninspected Iran nuclear site
stories.description: It says it has never been able to visit a uranium enrichment plant at Isfahan which Iran announced over a year ago.

stories.title: Two men guilty of spying for Iran over plan to target journalists and lawyer
stories.description: The men were convicted of engaging in conduct likely to assist an Iranian intelligence service.

stories.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
stories.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

stories.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
stories.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia dismisses commander of anti-Houthi coalition as rebels advance
stories.description: Saudi Arabia has removed the commander of the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen, state media said Monday, as the Iran-backed rebels advanced on the temporary capital of Aden. stories.title: Saudi Arabia dismisses commander of coalition forces fighting Houthis
stories.description: Move comes as government forces withdraw from Red Sea coast to halt Houthi approach to interim capital Aden.

stories.title: Iraq deploys army to stronghold of Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah
stories.description: US pressure on Iraq to curb Tehran's influence leaves potential for direct confrontation with Iran-linked armed group.

stories.title: Iran braces for natural gas shortages during winter energy imbalance
stories.description: The gas infrastructure in Iran has suffered from underdevelopment and sanctions, and now damage from the war.

stories.description: Oil tankers hit sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz

stories.title: Pakistan vows to proceed with US-Iran diplomacy and urges Afghanistan to act on terrorism
stories.description: Pakistan pledges to engage in diplomatic efforts to alleviate tensions between the US and Iran and urges Afghanistan to combat terrorism. Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar highlights the need for Taliban action during an international meeting in Islamabad.

stories.description: ADEN: Yemen’s armed forces have carried out 661 strikes against Houthi targets over the past several hours, killing or wounding 173 field commanders and fighters, the army’s spokesperson said on Monday. stories.title: Israel strikes eastern Lebanon near Syrian border, says it targeted weapons bound for Hezbollah
stories.description: LONDON: Israeli jets early on Monday struck a mountainous area in eastern Lebanon near the Syrian border, targeting what the Israeli military said was a weapons shipment bound for Hezbollah. stories.title: Coalition intercepts two Houthi drones launched towards Makkah and Riyadh
stories.description: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed two drones launched by Houthis targeting Makkah and Riyadh. The drones posed a threat to key locations in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Third American aircraft carrier arrives in West Asia as Trump keeps options open in Iran war
stories.description: The USS Theodore Roosevelt has arrived in the Middle East, once again bringing the total number of U.S. aircraft carriers in the West Asia to three, an unusually high number

stories.title: After Yemen setback, Saudi Arabia replaces military commander
stories.description: The Houthis have made rapid gains ⁠against the Saudi-backed Yemeni government since the U.S.-Iran conflict reignited Yemen’s frozen civil war this summer, drawing Riyadh back into confrontation with the group

stories.title: Yemeni government forces retreat from strait in major setback in war against Houthis
stories.description: Houthi gains in Yemen and attacks on Saudi Arabia and ‌Red Sea shipping in recent months have strengthened the position of Iran in the wider West Asia conflict ⁠launched by the United States and Israel in February
